title: Adversarial Training with Large Step Sizes: Implicit Bias, Optimization, and Sharpness
abstract: arXiv:2611.08457v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Adversarial Training (AT) is an important method for improving model robustness. We study the dynamics of deterministic Gradient Descent (GD) in AT. Most existing works in this direction focus on the small or vanishing step sizes regime, where GD resembles a continuous-time flow. However, such step sizes can make training inefficient and are rarely used in practice. In this paper, we study the AT dynamics of GD with large constant step sizes. We first study GD in adversarial linear logistic regression, focusing on two aspects: where the model parameters converge (implicit bias) and how quickly the losses decrease (optimization). We then turn to neural networks training and study how the sharpness of losses evolve during AT. translated_title: 大步长下的对抗训练：隐式偏差、优化与锐度
translated_abstract: 对抗训练是提高模型鲁棒性的重要方法。我们研究了确定性梯度下降（GD）在对抗训练中的动力学。该方向上大多数现有工作集中在小步长或步长趋于消失的情形，此时梯度下降类似于连续时间流。然而，这样的步长会使训练效率低下，在实践中很少被使用。在本文中，我们研究了采用大恒定步长的梯度下降在对抗训练中的动力学。我们首先研究了对抗线性逻辑回归中的梯度下降，重点关注两个方面：模型参数收敛到哪里（隐式偏差）以及损失下降的速度（优化）。随后我们转向神经网络训练，研究在对抗训练过程中损失锐度如何演化。我们的结果加深了对大步长梯度下降在对抗训练中行为的理解，并突出了其与标准训练（ST）中行为的三个关键差异：（i）对抗训练与标准训练之间的隐式偏差差距……
tldr: 本文研究了大恒定步长梯度下降在对抗训练中的动力学，从隐式偏差、优化速度和损失锐度演化三个方面揭示了其与标准训练的关键差异。
en_tdlr: This paper studies the dynamics of gradient descent with large constant step sizes in adversarial training, revealing key differences from standard training in terms of implicit bias, optimization speed, and loss sharpness evolution.
